propositions: Establish a nested `rebar bridge` CLI group with functional `preview` (read-only, dry-run mode) and `sync` (mutating, live mode) verbs while preserving legacy top-level spellings (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor).
Enforce strict verb isolation: reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and trailing arguments; unknown nested verbs fail with valid choices and never dispatch same-named top-level commands.

Bridge preview performs zero Jira writes and zero ticket/bridge-state writes; bridge sync performs persisted mutations from production-shaped fixtures while preserving unrelated state, proven by exact snapshots and transport logs.

Public help and documentation must omit internal vocabulary (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store) and numeric exit-code values, while preserving Mode, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode round trips.
Update CLI-reference generator, exit-codes, user-guide, and release-notes documentation to describe only the staged (preview/sync) surface that ships.
